message.text: `repeatsName` is a new helper whose body is one line, and the change calls it from one place only: `StateTree.removesOnly`, at `if (repeatsName(folders)) return false;`.

explanation.what: `repeatsName` is a new helper whose body is one line, and the change calls it from one place only: `StateTree.removesOnly`, at `if (repeatsName(folders)) return false;`.
explanation.whatToDo: Remove `repeatsName` and write its expression in `removesOnly`, as `new Set(folders.map((entry) => entry.path.toString("latin1"))).size !== folders.length`.
explanation.whyHere: The Code section of AGENTS.md says: "Inline single-line helpers that have one call site." This helper is exactly that case.

properties.failureScenario: Someone reading `removesOnly` reaches `repeatsName(folders)` and has to jump to a module-level function to find a one-line set-size comparison. Nothing else in the module calls it. AGENTS.md's rule says a helper of that shape is inlined at its one call site, and the change adds it as a standalone function.
